effect_construction.control_profile: sum control pseudobulk counts within each cell line, then log1p CPM
effect_construction.perturbation_profile: each target pseudobulk column converted independently to log1p CPM
effect_construction.effect: perturbation log1p CPM minus cell-line control log1p CPM
effect_construction.response_mask: exact intersection of globally complete source response symbols with the 18,533 challenge genes, in challenge order, excluding all 300 VCC targets and all 100 Broad targets
effect_construction.missing_pairs: retain the seven frozen missing pairs as unavailable; tune and test target splits must remain complete in all 16 contexts

target_split.method: sort the 90 analysis targets by lowercase SHA-256 of the UTF-8 target symbol, then symbol; first 54 fit, next 18 tune, final 18 test

model_fit.response_basis: deterministic randomized right SVD of uncentered fit-target effects from training batches, with equal total weight per batch and per target
model_fit.control_basis: global transductive PCA of the 16 control log1p-CPM profiles using equal total weight per batch; no perturbation outcomes enter this PCA
model_fit.context_baseline_for_gain_fit: for each training context and fit target, equal-batch mean over the other training batches
model_fit.context_gain: least-squares relative coefficient deviation per response program, then equal-batch weighted mean centering
model_fit.ridge: weighted no-intercept ridge from centered standardized control-PC scores to centered gains, using the exact preregistered lambda
model_fit.held_input: equal-batch mean target effect over all non-held training batches
model_fit.transform: q_prime = q + beta * U * (predicted_gain elementwise_multiply U_transpose_q)
model_fit.angular_cap: scale only the residual along its ray by deterministic 60-step bisection until the q-to-q_prime angle is at most the preregistered cap
model_fit.row_norm: restore the original q L2 norm after the angular cap

validation.outer: six experimental-batch holdouts; each batch receives equal macro weight and contexts are averaged within batch
validation.inner: for each outer fold, leave one of the remaining batches out on the 18 tune targets and select over the complete fixed Cartesian grid
validation.selection_metric: maximum inner macro raw PDS delta versus identity
validation.test: evaluate the selected candidate once on the untouched 18 test targets in the outer held batch
validation.pds: raw uncentered cosine ranking with exact midranks; each held context uses the complete 18-target gallery
validation.shallow_deep: within each outer fold split the 18 test targets at the median held-input L2 norm, with SHA-256 target order as the deterministic tie break

nulls.context_label: derange the 16 control-score rows globally while leaving effect outcomes fixed; repeat complete nested selection
nulls.target_pairing: independently derange target labels within each cell line and within each fixed fit/tune/test split; repeat complete nested selection
nulls.target_pairing_basis_invariance: within-split permutations preserve the exact response-row multiset used by every basis fit
nulls.geometry_only: zero gain and equal-batch mean centered gain both reduce exactly to identity
nulls.wrong_context: diagnostic deterministic global context derangement applied to held control scores after real selection

final_candidate.selection: one six-fold leave-one-batch-out tune-target selection over all source batches
final_candidate.fit: refit the selected model on all six batches using fit targets only
